name: What is a flexible commission real estate listing?

mainEntity.name: What is a flexible commission real estate listing?

acceptedAnswer.text: A flexible commission real estate listing allows homeowners to negotiate or choose from different commission structures when selling their property. This can differ from traditional fixed-rate models, offering sellers more control over the fees paid to real estate agents. For example, some models might offer a lower commission if the seller finds the buyer themselves, or a tiered structure based on the sale price. Understanding these options can help you align the commission with the level of service you need.
acceptedAnswer.description: A flexible commission real estate listing offers sellers customizable commission structures, providing more control over agent fees.
